title: Isaiah's Prophecy about the Prince of Peace
description: The prophet Isaiah proclaims that the people walking in darkness will see a great light. A child will be born, a son will be given, and the government will rest on his shoulder. He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. His kingdom will be established with justice and righteousness on David's throne from now on forever.
